mechanism_narrative: The recent rebound in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT signals more commuting and destination trips, which increases passing trade for malls and street retail within four weeks, raising RETAIL_REC relative to the last four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -60.9 to -42.0 and TRANSIT from -64.6 to -53.9 over four weeks
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT continue improving for four weeks but RETAIL_REC does not rise above its prior four-week mean, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while WORKPLACES remains depressed, more activity is concentrated near home and short errand trips replace discretionary shopping, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above 30 while WORKPLACES remains below -40
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is 32.1 and WORKPLACES is -42.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If residential remains above 30 and workplaces remains below -40 but RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks, this mechanism is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A continued recovery in GROCERY_PHARM reflects trip chaining and essential travel normalization, which spills over into nearby convenience and retail visits and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -18.4 to -14.3 while TRANSIT improved from -62.1 to -53.9
failure_condition: If grocery/pharmacy mobility improves for four weeks without a corresponding increase in retail/recreation relative to the prior four weeks, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp weekly drop in TRANSIT indicates mobility restrictions or travel frictions that immediately suppress discretionary shopping trips, causing RETAIL_REC to fall within one week.

failure_condition: If TRANSIT falls by more than 5 points week-on-week and RETAIL_REC does not fall within the next week, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained weakness in PARKS signals low outdoor leisure intensity, which reduces bundled shopping and recreation outings and keeps RETAIL_REC below its recent average over the next four weeks.
